desc: A co-op guest's own character touches the host's enemy: in the Rogueport Sewers (tik_01) the guest (seat 2, the partner) walks its own character, in its own game, away from Mario; the host puts its Spiky Goomba a little further on (TTYD_SYNC_ENEMY_TO_SEAT: the map's own enemy, moved for the test) and the guest's stick walks straight at it (TTYD_SYNC_OWN_SEEK); the host's game, which puts the character where the guest's says, has its enemy touched and starts the battle, shared, and both are back in the field after

log_must: co-op: seat 2's character walked by player 2's own game
test: the enemy .* put by seat 2's character
battle \d+: what the battle changed goes to the others
co-op: this guest walks its own character \(seat 2\)
battle \d+: the shared party's HP \d+, FP \d+, star power \d+ kept here
